default.title: Order review and CRM communications
default.summary: Review orders without losing your place, see provider activity and tracking history, read imported email cleanly, and choose verified email senders and connected calendars. Sign-in codes stay out of customer interactions.
features: Orders supports paged review, sorting and filters with navigation state preserved in the URL
CRM email shows readable text and safe clickable links while preserving the original saved message
Email sender selection includes the connected account's verified primary address and accepted aliases
Meeting scheduling keeps the connected calendar choice separate from email sender selection
Shopify order history includes available provider activity messages and author names, with partial-history coverage shown explicitly
fixes: Refreshing a stale order result preserves the selected page, filters and open order whenever that page still exists
Order history omits redundant generic tracking rows while keeping every distinct tracking number and change
Concurrent order refreshes use consistent account and store-control locking
Renamed Gmail accounts are checked against their current provider identity before sending
ClawPilot sign-in-code emails are excluded before CRM message storage or customer association
Delayed CRM synchronization cannot restore an archived interaction
Meeting calendar choice, duration and location mode survive CRM synchronization
New tracking links are retained without rewriting original order-history evidence
An account-bound self-delivery setting keeps branded sign-in codes visible in the operator's Inbox
